summary: NuRAN Wireless filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an November 5, 2026 press release describing its transition from equipment manufacturer to Network-as-a-Service operator in rural Africa. The release cites 5,092 contracted towers across eight countries representing over US$900 million in estimated contract revenue over five-to-ten-year terms, roughly 300 operational towers, 126.44% network-generated revenue growth, and average monthly revenue of US$1,356 per tower. It references the 2021 Orange NaaS agreement targeting 2,000 towers. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanics are present; this is corporate promotion, not a special situation.
